rules.feature: File tree, workspace mount and composer
checks: Existing/new/unknown composer layouts, missing and ambiguous anchors, navigation and disposal.

Collapsed inert/aria-hidden sidebar rows do not compete with the active thread; A/B retain independent saved connections, true multiple active IDs remain ambiguous, and New Chat keeps draft selection.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: Open an existing conversation and New Chat. Confirm the file tree follows the correct workspace and the composer remains usable.
Navigate away/back and close the view. Confirm there is one tree and no stale controls.

checks: Identity match without forced refresh; expired versus unavailable credentials; active-turn refusal and late replies.

Manual Verify returns verified login status independently of remote quota availability, then schedules the existing background quota queue. Verify and usage reuse observe_managed credentials without duplicate frontend Verify; quota failure does not fail successful login checks. Cached values, one-flight and owner/late-result protections remain. No quota-triggered backend replacement or extra retry counter.

Usable native getAuthStatus credentials avoid forced account/read; near-expiry, missing claims and confirmed reauthorization retain existing refresh behavior. Wrong identity, logout/relogin, removed connection and late replies cannot commit stale results. Local credential selection is not blocked by a hung remote quota read.

Failed/interrupted primary setup must release ordinary route switching and disable; explicit cancel distinguishes canceled, notFound and missing loginId. Pre-dispatch failures do not claim OAuth started. A real pending login retains existing admission. No OAuth write replay or new polling.

Quota presentation distinguishes explicit connection failure, response deadline, incomplete data and generic unavailable. ACCOUNT_BACKEND/ACCOUNT_STREAM_UNCLASSIFIED alone must not imply offline or expired login. Preserve cached percentages and original diagnostic code. Current-thread terminal connection errors use existing notice, never automatic replay or extra RPC; isolated browser fixture does not certify real provider delivery.

Local native.status/shared.status snapshots reuse an already-held owner lease and current document without official account/read; unknown/ended/retired sessions cannot leak another owner, and snapshot results never replace native.ensure/send/mutation admission. Reselecting a committed connection uses native.ensure, with stale-route repair and original busy/cancellation behavior.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: In an idle test conversation select a previously verified child, then the primary account. Confirm identity and quota update without another login.
Separately test a signed-out/expired connection and an unavailable network; cached quota must not be described as a login failure.

In an idle disposable installation start/cancel a primary-account authorization, including an interrupted receipt. Confirm ordinary account switching and disable remain usable after interruption, and that canceled differs from notFound/unconfirmed. Do not change the active user login automatically.

rules.feature: Native model picker and API catalogs
checks: API saved model subset and default; native model/effort selection; official catalog restore; missing or ambiguous capability.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: Open the native model picker for an API connection: confirm only saved models appear and default/effort selection works.
Return to an official account and confirm its native catalog and keyboard selection are restored.

checks: Light/dark native theme, background activation/deactivation and unchanged controls/media.

Spectral Drape uses shared ManagedBackgroundController, independent Worker first-frame, native settings surface transparency and theme lease. Test download without activation, parameter/reset persistence, shared ASCII panel, reduced-motion/paused idle, startup copy and cleanup; no account/switch checks or new waits.

Spectral click uses visible folded-surface NDC and CSS offset/DPR-independent pointer coordinates; offset canvas multi-point uniform regression. Saved live defaults and dot SVG icon match panel; startup animation selector includes spectral. Brush path stays unchanged.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: With a background enabled, inspect light and dark themes, then disable it. Confirm native controls and media retain their geometry.

checks: Current/stale/legacy/partial report metadata; late status after close; fixed retry admission and keyboard navigation.

Separate inventory and compatibility identities; immutable validation runs, no hidden update after zero-delta analysis refresh, unknown changes remain involved, partial checks remain manual and stale rules/engine require explicit revalidation.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: Open the Code-Codex menu in Chinese and English. Confirm validation counts and keyboard navigation.
Close the menu during a status read; it must not reopen or change focus when the reply arrives.

rules.feature: Bridge, module loading and host runtime
checks: Trusted module discovery and bridge fields; missing/ambiguous contracts; cancellation and resource release.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: In a disposable conversation verify one native request and cancellation. Confirm disconnect/unknown outcome is reported without automatic replay.

rules.feature: Native local tools, permissions and protocol
checks: Local tool and approval protocol; activity/ownership checks; no request replay after unknown outcomes.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: Use a disposable conversation for a tool/approval turn. Confirm cancel and denied approval do not replay a request.

rules.feature: Official executable, launch and package identity
checks: Trusted package identity, native launch ownership, old/new/unknown versions and uninstall cleanup.

Activation helper is compiled and embedded at build time, loaded from memory without runtime Add-Type or TEMP DLL output. Verify ASCII/Chinese/Arabic/emoji TEMP load and open-stdin supervision; real packaged activation/identity/armed termination remain separate acceptance.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: At a convenient idle time close and launch the official client using Code-Codex. Confirm native identity and tree readiness.
Uninstall/cleanup requires a separate disposable installation; do not uninstall the active user installation.

rules.feature: Launch-owned account transport and native backend startup
checks: Enabled cold launch versus disabled/not-installed launch; shared official backend spawn contract and native proxy/TLS transport.
Root/subagent ownership, mismatched identity, missing lineage, active request and cancelled/failed startup; no alternate-account fallback.
Existing plugin disable/re-enable behavior and session settings remain unchanged.

Native packaged cold launch preserves package identity through its registered execution alias and honors CODEX_CLI_PATH before startup config and actor creation; disabled plugin uses unchanged shell activation.

Native stdio wrapper preserves CLI arguments, startup config, JSONL, tools and permissions; control endpoint and thread lineage preserve owner, active-request and disable/re-enable behavior. Legacy inspector path remains supported.

Native cold startup, initial official request, first account switch, backend exit, network reconnect and core hot handoff require separate observation. Static token matching does not certify runtime behavior.

Existing conversations and New Chat drafts share one loopback listener and HTTP client per account service, with distinct capability paths and per-conversation credentials, context, quota and cancellation. Two conversations may use the same account; switching one cannot change the other.

Parallel requests remain isolated; closing or cancelling one route leaves the other usable. Unknown/closed capability paths cannot route to another conversation. The initial loopback probe is reused by later routes without additional identity/quota reads, retries or switching waits.

New Chat refuses inference before the native thread binding and accepts it after binding on the same listener. Cover official/API routes, existing and new chats, disabled/re-enabled plugin and network reconnect separately; real provider success and timing require actual host/service acceptance.

Same-version retired native bindings cannot cancel current startup, claim document ownership or release the working endpoint again; include legacy slot assignment, failed unreleased candidate, current binding reconnection and new-document reset. This is local lifecycle admission only: no added account switch/auth/quota reads, retry or waiting.

Within one startup transport operation reuse the verified descriptor and HTTP client across status/route/bind. Preserve listener ownership, capability/proof, active-request rejection, legacy/API fallback, failed replies and default restore; no descriptor is cached across operations.

Activation helper is compiled and embedded at build time, loaded from memory without runtime Add-Type or TEMP DLL output. Verify ASCII/Chinese/Arabic/emoji TEMP load and open-stdin supervision; real packaged activation/identity/armed termination remain separate acceptance.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: At idle, restart with the plugin enabled, open an existing conversation and New Chat, then select a verified child; confirm fast switching and original permission/tool behavior.
In two disposable conversations choose the same account, switch one, then close one. Confirm the other retains its own account/context and still works.
Separately test disable/re-enable and a network reconnect. Confirm no cross-conversation routing, duplicate send or stale owner.

rules.feature: Responses history, tool pairing and provider-scoped opaque context
checks: Official to API to official history, provider-scoped opaque state, original archive preservation and bounded readable handoff.
Duplicate/missing call_id, incomplete compaction, cancelled/unknown outcome and compressed/oversized body refusals.
HTTP/SSE completion and errors; real provider tools and multi-turn behavior require separate explicit acceptance.

Return from API restores the latest original official compaction checkpoint plus readable progress without rewriting the archive or summarizing native history. Foreign reasoning is isolated; repeated provider cycles and live official stream state before archive flush preserve provenance.

Legacy native pass-through learns accepted official opaque state only after successful completion. Unknown ciphertext, missing replacement history and corrupt/backwards provenance are explicit failures, never guessed ownership or silent history replacement.

Encrypted-context diagnostics link a captured official workspace/connection fingerprint, input before and after projection, completed output fingerprint, bounded error code and safe hashed item reference. Diagnostic bounds omit samples without altering native HTTP/WebSocket requests or response bytes.

Native agent companion-page function_call_output records with no call_id are reference data, not executed tool results. Project only verified names/metadata to user-priority quoted context; preserve full output. Genuine orphan tool results and unknown shapes still fail.

Exact encrypted reasoning rejected in structured native task-complete errors or a matching sent upstream item is isolated only in the outbound copy on a later explicit request. Keep official compaction, readable history and real tool results. No automatic inference replay and no original archive mutation.

For a request containing known rejected reasoning, rebuild its failed history without other encrypted reasoning before the latest user boundary; retain active-turn reasoning, native compaction and visible task/tool records. Count known rejections separately from other historical reasoning omitted. Clean native checkpoints without rejected bytes remain unchanged.

Prepare loads recovery evidence once and transfers it to Handoff; ordinary reasoning builds response attribution without the former duplicate hashing pass. Exact rejected/history isolation, archive identity and no automatic replay remain.

Diagnostic-only request-local encrypted-item indexes must survive overlapping HTTP/WS projections without changing recovery/forwarding policy. Rejection events correlate operation/sampling, native input cipher and current recovery index; missing association stays explicit. No extra credential read, ciphertext hash pass, archive scan, retry or wait.

Actual encrypted-context root cause remains unproven without matching producer/route/request evidence. Native compact completion and unchanged original archive prefix are separate from ordinary chat acceptance; runtime logs retain their bounded5MiB/10-run scope.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: In a disposable conversation use an official account, switch to API, then return to official. Check readable history and tool continuity for two turns.
Cancellation, compaction and encrypted-context errors require preserved evidence; do not rewrite the user archive to make the test pass.

In disposable official-account conversations compare same-account continuation, same-account close/reopen and A to B to A. Join item and opaque fingerprints with workspace fingerprint and operation/sampling sequence. A real quota-credit reset requires explicit user action and before/after controls. Missing older provenance remains unknown.

At idle recover an actually failed long conversation using its recorded invalid_encrypted_content evidence. Confirm successful native compaction and a later normal message; separately check disable/default-route behavior and keep the original failure evidence.

rules.feature: Native composer quota subscriptions and dismissible usage banners
checks: Exhausted primary with usable child/API: native send subscription reflects selected identity; permissions/auth remain owned by host.
Usage-card close across native card layouts; per-owner/thread/account/model/reset identity, native close reuse and reset/disposal restoration.
Missing/ambiguous native quota roles and unrelated image/media/paywall cards remain protected.

New Chat and existing native composer: optional isResponseInProgress omitted/undefined or boolean false/true must qualify through the same mounted owner/context/subscription contract; invalid values, missing and ambiguous owners remain rejected.

Exhausted host with usable child/API projects only the three native quota snapshots. Existing native permission/auth/busy blocks stay enforced; returning to host, inactive/changed conversation, foreign replacement and disposal restore or stop only owned projection. Controlled child Send forwards the original callback exactly once with unchanged draft; actual remote first-turn success is a separate host/service acceptance.

Same-version selector correction uses its existing revision-based idle replacement and retains the verified execution adapter/routes; active preparation or turns defer view replacement without an added switching wait.

Actual native ComposerScope home identity is kind=new/entrypoint=home without placement or conversationId. Local main identity and legacy new/main stay supported; panels, previews, library, side, wrong thread, distinct matching contexts and missing identity are rejected. Exercise alias context reuse and store/derived-holder dependency forms through all three quota leases and the original Send callback, not just the owner predicate.
A projected quota-ready operation and its composer caller share one React animation-frame wait; unchanged draft, replaced controls, disabled/error and disposal still prevent duplicate or late sends.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: With an exhausted primary and a usable child/API, test New Chat and an existing conversation. Confirm the original Send action runs once with the unchanged draft.
Close the native usage card, switch back, navigate and dispose. Confirm quota projection restores only its owned subscriptions; permission/auth/busy blocks remain native.

rules.feature: Composer account control continuity and native RPC observation
checks: Send-to-thinking transition, composer/control replacement, readable busy state and first-switch preparation hint.
Stable account identity across ordering/navigation, late RPC/closed panel cleanup and activity admission.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: Send in a disposable conversation and watch the account control through preparation, Thinking and composer replacement. Confirm its identity remains readable and no duplicate control appears.

rules.feature: Quota-exhaustion continuation including API model and effort binding
checks: Official to API and API to next account in saved order; API balance remains unverified and is not read via official quota.
Exact model/effort inheritance or saved default/medium, native settings confirmation before dispatch.
Duplicate terminal events, cancelled task, transient throttling/network/permission errors and active turn do not trigger duplicate continuation.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: Using a disposable task with an actually exhausted account, confirm continuation follows saved order, including API, and reuses a supported model/effort or saved default/medium.
Cancel or reproduce a transient network error; neither case may trigger duplicate continuation. This test can spend provider credit and must be deliberate.

rules.feature: Shared native settings and secondary navigation background contracts
checks: Settings shared shell/groups including display:contents wrappers, secondary pages and inline header pseudo backgrounds.
Three background attributes, light/dark, disable restoration; protect dialogs/menus/media/conversation masks and native control geometry.
rules.manualReason: Full behavioral acceptance needs a different mounted page, a lifecycle transition, deliberate credentials/provider use or an isolated test installation; read-only contracts do not execute those operations in the active conversation.
manualSteps: Open Settings and representative left-rail secondary pages with the background enabled. Confirm shell/groups are transparent in light and dark themes.
Disable the background. Confirm dialogs, menus, media and native control geometry are restored.
